anomalies.description: A large, sudden explosion occurs on the road ahead of a group of people, producing a massive white and brown dust/fireball plume that rapidly expands and obscures the scene.

A large, sudden explosion occurs on the roadside embankment, producing a rapidly expanding fireball and dust cloud that peaks around 14.5–15.0 s and begins to collapse by 16.5 s.; A large, violent explosion occurs on the roadside, producing a fireball, dense smoke plume, and a rapidly expanding dust/steam cloud that engulfs the area over ~7.5 seconds.

A second distinct explosion occurs at the same location, with a new fireball and dust plume rising, indicating either a secondary detonation or residual burning reigniting; visible from 18.0 s onward.; A large, violent explosion occurs on the roadside, beginning with a rapid upward ejection of dust and debris (f0), quickly forming a massive hemispherical dust cloud that expands outward (f1–f6), then collapses inward as the initial shock dissipates (f7–f8), revealing a burning fireball and thick black smoke rising from the epicenter (f9–f15). The explosion is sustained and evolves over the full interval.

A large, violent explosion occurs in the distance on a roadside embankment, producing a rapidly expanding fireball, dense black and brown smoke plume, and significant dust/debris ejection. The explosion intensifies from frame f0 to f7 (peaking around 27.5s), then gradually decays through f15, with visible flames persisting throughout.
A large, rapidly expanding fireball and smoke plume erupts on the right side of the road, consistent with a sudden explosion. The blast is fully visible in f0 and begins to dissipate by f1.

A group of people is seen running away from the explosion site along the roadside, indicating collective flight from a violent incident. Their movement is urgent and coordinated, suggesting unrest or response to an explosive event.
